description: BubbleBoost Chrome Extension - Performance analyzer for Bubble.io apps with real-time scoring and fix suggestions

userStories.title: Initialize Plasmo extension project with TypeScript
userStories.description: Set up the foundational Plasmo project structure with TypeScript, React, and Tailwind CSS configured
acceptanceCriteria: Run: pnpm create plasmo bubbleboost --with-tailwindcss
Update manifest to use Manifest V3
Configure permissions: activeTab, storage only
Add content script match pattern for *.bubble.io/*
npm run build succeeds
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add Zustand store for extension state
userStories.description: Create state management for score, issues, and UI state
acceptanceCriteria: Install zustand package
Create store with: score (number), issues (array), isActive (boolean), isPremium (boolean)
Add actions: setScore, addIssue, clearIssues, setActive, setPremium
Store persists to chrome.storage.local
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create Bubble editor detection in content script
userStories.description: Detect when user is on Bubble editor and activate extension
acceptanceCriteria: Content script runs on *.bubble.io/* pages
Detects editor URLs: /page*, /version-*, /edit*
Sets isActive=true in store when on editor
Sets isActive=false on non-editor pages
Sends message to background script on state change
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create floating score badge component
userStories.description: Build the draggable floating badge that shows performance score
acceptanceCriteria: Badge renders in bottom-right corner of page
Shows score 0-100 with color: green (80-100), yellow (50-79), red (0-49)
Badge is draggable to reposition
Position persists in storage
Clicking badge dispatches 'openPanel' action
Badge has minimize/expand toggle
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement first 5 DOM analysis checks
userStories.description: Create analyzers for element count, repeating group nesting, visible elements, condition complexity, custom states
acceptanceCriteria: Check 1: Count total elements, warn >100, critical >200
Check 2: Detect repeating group nesting, warn >2 levels
Check 3: Count visible elements on load, warn >50
Check 4: Count conditions per element, warn >5
Check 5: Count custom states, warn >20
Each check returns: id, name, status (pass/warn/critical), count, message
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement checks 6-10: reusable duplication, images, dynamic text, hidden elements, group nesting
userStories.description: Add analyzers for reusable elements, image dimensions, dynamic text, hidden elements, group nesting depth
acceptanceCriteria: Check 6: Detect same reusable element >3 times, warn
Check 7: Find images without width/height constraints, warn
Check 8: Count text elements with dynamic expressions, info
Check 9: Count hidden but loaded elements, warn >20
Check 10: Measure group nesting depth, warn >5 levels
All checks follow same return interface as US-005
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement checks 11-15: floating groups, input validation, option sets, plugins, workflows
userStories.description: Add final 5 analyzers for floating groups, input validation, option sets, plugins, workflow triggers
acceptanceCriteria: Check 11: Count floating groups, warn >3
Check 12: Detect complex input validation, warn >3 rules per input
Check 13: Find large option sets, warn >50 options
Check 14: Count plugins on page, warn >5
Check 15: Count workflow triggers, warn >10 per page
All checks follow same return interface
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create score calculation engine
userStories.description: Build deterministic scoring algorithm that weighs all 15 checks
acceptanceCriteria: Score ranges 0-100
Critical issues deduct 10 points each
Warning issues deduct 3 points each
Info issues deduct 0 points
Same page state produces identical score every time
Score updates stored in Zustand
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create issue breakdown panel UI
userStories.description: Build the main panel that displays all detected issues organized by severity
acceptanceCriteria: Panel opens when badge is clicked
Issues grouped by severity: Critical (red), Warning (yellow), Info (blue)
Each issue shows: title, count, impact description
Panel header shows totals: 'X Critical, Y Warnings, Z Info'
Panel has close button
Panel is scrollable for many issues
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add fix suggestions data and UI
userStories.description: Create fix suggestion templates for each check type and display in panel
acceptanceCriteria: Each of 15 checks has associated fix suggestion template
Suggestions include: title, description, steps to fix
Clicking issue expands to show fix suggestion
Fix text is copy-able to clipboard
Each fix shows estimated impact: High/Medium/Low
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add auto-analysis trigger with debouncing
userStories.description: Automatically run analysis when page loads and when DOM changes
acceptanceCriteria: Analysis runs automatically on page load
MutationObserver detects DOM changes
Changes debounced to 2 seconds before re-analysis
Score badge updates within 3 seconds of changes
Results cached until next change
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add network request monitoring
userStories.description: Intercept and analyze network requests to Bubble backend
acceptanceCriteria: Use chrome.webRequest API to intercept requests
Track: request count, total bytes, response times
Flag queries returning >100 rows as warning
Flag API calls >2 seconds as warning
Group requests by type: database, workflow, external
Display network stats in panel
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add premium feature gates with lock icons
userStories.description: Show lock icons on premium features and upgrade prompts
acceptanceCriteria: Lock icon appears on: PDF Export, JSON Deep Scan, AI Explanations
Clicking locked feature shows upgrade modal
Modal explains premium benefits
Modal has 'Upgrade' button placeholder (links to #)
isPremium flag in store controls gate visibility
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add JSON deep scan UI (premium placeholder)
userStories.description: Create UI for JSON export analysis feature gated behind premium
acceptanceCriteria: Deep Scan button in panel (locked for free)
Premium users see file upload input

Placeholder message: 'JSON analysis coming soon'

acceptanceCriteria: Install jspdf package
Export button in panel (locked for free)

PDF includes: score, issue breakdown, fix recommendations

userStories.title: Integrate PostHog analytics
userStories.description: Add PostHog tracking for key user events
acceptanceCriteria: Install posthog-js package
Initialize PostHog in background script
Track events: scan_started, scan_completed, issue_clicked, fix_viewed, upgrade_clicked

Respect Do Not Track browser setting
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add Supabase license validation
userStories.description: Check premium license status against Supabase on extension load
acceptanceCriteria: Install @supabase/supabase-js package
Create Supabase client with anon key (env var placeholder)
On extension load, check license table for user
Store isPremium status in Zustand
Cache license status for 24 hours
Handle offline gracefully (use cached status)

userStories.title: Add extension popup with quick stats
userStories.description: Create browser action popup showing quick status and score
acceptanceCriteria: Popup shows: current score, active/inactive status, issue count summary

userStories.title: Add badge icon state management
userStories.description: Update extension badge icon and text based on state
acceptanceCriteria: Badge shows 'ON' text when on Bubble editor
Badge shows score number when analysis complete
Badge background color matches score: green/yellow/red

Badge updates via chrome.action API

userStories.description: Verify all quality gates pass and extension builds for Chrome Web Store
acceptanceCriteria: npm run lint passes with no errors
npm run type-check passes with no errors

All features work in manual testing
